system: Two explicitly defined organosulfur chloromethyl precursors and their dissociative one-electron products, with a ferrocene reference couple.

species.label: 1a carbon fragment
species.role: neutral carbon-centered radical after C-Cl cleavage

species.label: 1h carbon fragment
species.role: neutral carbon-centered radical after C-S cleavage

species.label: ferrocene
species.coordination: Single bis(eta5-cyclopentadienyl)iron sandwich complex. The disconnected SMILES records formal fragments only; it does not mean three separated solutes. Construct both five-membered Cp rings eta5-coordinated to the same Fe, preserving ten ring carbons and ten hydrogens.

species.label: ferrocenium
species.coordination: Single bis(eta5-cyclopentadienyl)iron sandwich cation with the same ligand connectivity as ferrocene. The disconnected SMILES records formal fragments only; construct the eta5 coordination, not isolated ions.
